title.narrative: Building Bridges through Leadership Training (BBLT) and Building Bridges through Leadership Training Junior (BBLTJ) phase 2

description.narrative: The project ‘Building Bridges through Leadership Training (BBLT) and Building Bridges through Leadership Training Junior (BBLTJ) phase 2’, supported by the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands (EKN) and implemented by Bangladesh Youth Leadership Center (BYLC), is designed to create a just, prosperous, and inclusive Bangladesh driven by courageous, compassionate, and competent leaders. In this five-year-long project (October 2021–September 2026), 3,000 youth from diverse socioeconomic backgrounds will receive leadership training. This training will help them to develop leadership skills, moral understanding, social and communication skills, tolerance towards differing ideologies and viewpoints, thinking skills, emotional intelligence, public speaking, civic awareness, and project management skills.
